title: 情報のための数学Ⅱ
subtitle: Mathematics for Informatics II
courseType: Mathematics and Science ProgramMathematics and Science Courses
educationalGoal:
Students will:
(1) Learn basic probabilities, conditional probabilities, and Bayes' theorem.
(2) Learn basic data organization and statistics.
(3) Be able to organize data using Excel.
advice:
This is a basic course in mathematics and statistics. We will cover the following topics:

1. Basic probabilities: Permutations and combinations, probabilities, conditional probabilities and Bayes' theorem.
2. A data analysis method using statistics: Frequency distribution table, histogram, correlation diagram, mean/variance, covariance/correlation coefficient.

Students are expected to understand above materials.
Students are expected to process data using Excel (computer spreadsheet software).
Students are expected to complete the exercises on their own without consulting/copying others.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.

achievementLevels.ideal:
Demonstrate a 90% achievement level in the following areas:
(1) Correctly calculate permutations and combinations.
(2) Correctly calculate probabilities and conditional probabilities, and apply Bayes' theorem.
(3) Understand the concept of probability and be able to apply it to actual probabilistic problems.
(4) Understand the basics of statistics, accurately determine characteristic values of data, and create effective data visualizations.
achievementLevels.standard:
Demonstrate a 60% achievement level in the following areas:
(1) Calculate permutations and combinations.
(2) Calculate probabilities and conditional probabilities, and apply Bayes' theorem.
(3) Understand the concept of probability and be able to apply it to actual probabilistic problems.
(4) Understand the basics of statistics, accurately determine characteristic values of data, and create effective data visualizations.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              This is a basic course in mathematics and statistics. We will cover the following topics:

1. Basic probabilities: Permutations and combinations, probabilities, conditional probabilities and Bayes' theorem.
2. A data analysis method using statistics: Frequency distribution table, histogram, correlation diagram, mean/variance, covariance/correlation coefficient.

Students are expected to understand above materials.
Students are expected to process data using Excel (computer spreadsheet software).
Students are expected to complete the exercises on their own without consulting/copying others.
Students are expected to utilize the Math. and Science Education Research Center or the office hours of the teacher.
